stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Capital Finance Holdings Limited provides diverse short-term financial solutions throughout mainland China and Hong Kong. Its service portfolio encompasses pawn loans, entrusted lending arrangements, micro-credit facilities, expert financial consultancy, and the management of problematic debt assets. The firm operated as Ming Kei Holdings Limited until November 2014, when it transitioned to its current name. Its primary administrative office is situated in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
